notes: The 'upon' of 'riding upon horses' goes to the rectum under rule 19's recast-preposition clause, since the construct participle רֹכְבֵי keeps its own English word 'riding' — rule 44's supplied-preposition clause reaches only a bare direct object, which this is not.
Neither noun of 'the uttermost parts of the north' carries an article morpheme, so both written 'the's are supplied, each to the phrase it opens (rules 29, 15).
